entries.land_location_as_stated: 100 acres of woods, swamp, cranberry bog & gardens on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts
entries.description: A 100-acre farm with woods, swamp, cranberry bog, and gardens on Silver Lake in the South Shore area of Massachusetts, where two women live and are organizing a land trust. They offer camping, open space, farmwork experience, and longer-term apprenticeships to lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl and boy children, and explicitly reject lesbian separatism.
entries.raw_text: FEATHERS FARM Box 19, Bryantville, MA 02327 (617)585-3826. My partner & I are the only residents of Feathers Farm, 100 acres of woods, swamp, cranberry bog & gardens on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts. We have camping facilities/open space/ farmwork experience to women and children. We are currently working to organize support and resources for a land trust to control this property. We have found lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating approach to this endeavor and expect unconditional acceptance of this from our visitors (whom we welcome AND encourage). We request that visitors bring their own food & donate $4/night camping fee, flexible. We often work out other arrangements for longer term apprenticeships or short term large groups. It is helpful if visits are preceeded by at least a phone-call, preferably a letter.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land by the two-woman rule ("My partner & I are the only residents of Feathers Farm"); the land is not yet in a land trust ("currently working to organize support and resources for a land trust to control this property"). Mailing address is a PO box ("Box 19"), so land_street_address, land_city, and land_zip are left blank; land_state is MA from "South Shore area of Massachusetts". Accepted groups: "to women and children" before 1986 gives Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, and Boy children. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency from "cranberry bog & gardens" and "farmwork experience"; Workshops/education from "longer term apprenticeships". Explicitly rejects lesbian separatism ("We have found lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating approach").

entries.description: A community of 4 lesbians living and working on 113 acres of mountain woodland in Troy, Maine, with permanent structures and camping space, offering parcels for sale or building and welcoming new members and residents, lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: WOMONGROUND Rt 1, Box 2420, Troy, ME 04987. 113 acres of Maine mountains/woodland. Parcels available for sale and/or building. Also plenty of space for camping, hiking, raspberry picking. Will answer all letters promptly. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women, lesbians interested in buying land. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 113 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, women working and living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative: 4 lesbians living on the land ("We have/are: 4 lesbians... women working and living on the land") and welcoming "new members/residents". Mailing address is a rural route ("Rt 1, Box 2420"), so copied to land_*. Residents: 4 from "We have/are: 4 lesbians... women working and living on the land". Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory and "lesbians interested in buying land"), Non-lesbian women ("nonlesbian women"), Girl children ("girl children").

entries.description: A 20-acre property in Vermont with a creek, woods, open land, and two lesbian-built dwellings without plumbing or electricity, owned by a lesbian collective none of whom currently live there; currently rented to non-lesbian/non-gay tenants, with the collective seeking lesbian renters.
entries.raw_text: GENEROUS EARTH LAND Box 51A, Hinesburg, VT 05461. 20 acres, creek, woods, open. 2 dyke-built dwellings, one large, one small. No plumbing or electricity. None of the dyke collective owners live there now. It's rented to hets. Interested in dyke renters. 15 miles from town with jobs. Write before visiting.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative: owned by a "dyke collective". Residents: 0 because "None of the dyke collective owners live there now" and current tenants from outside the community ("It's rented to hets") are not counted as community residents. Mailing address is a box with no road ("Box 51A"), so land_street_address, land_city, and land_zip are left blank; land_state is VT from mailing state. Accepted groups: Lesbian women from "Interested in dyke renters" and "Write before visiting"; current non-member tenants ("hets") are not coded as accepted groups per codebook.

entries.land_location_as_stated: gorgeous secluded land; maple sugar bush
entries.description: A working vegetarian homestead farm in Vermont with a maple sugar bush, draft horse, dairy goats, chickens, and organic food production, offering year-round retreat or temporary living space, campsites, cross-country ski weekends, summer work exchanges, and workshops, as well as welcoming new community members and leasing land to women to build a cabin or tipi.
entries.raw_text: GREENHOPE Box 226, E Hardwick, VT 05836. (802)533-7772. At present we are a working homestead farm. We offer year round space to women needing retreat or temporary living situation. We have gorgeous secluded land and campsites. Hope to build visitor cabins this summer. Women from the Boston area visit almost every weekend. Right now we are offering x-country ski weekends - $35 plus meals is the fee. In summer we offer work exchange. We have an all lesbian maple sugar bush - the only one I know of. We work with a draft horse, raise dairy goats and chickens. We are vegetarians raising nearly all our food organically here.
